268	
269	        // Verify that the investor has not refunded
270	        _verifyHasNotRefunded(positionId);
271	
272	        // Verify that the vesting configuration is valid
273	        _verifyValidVestingConfig(investorVestingConfig);
274	
275	        // Verify that the investor is eligible to claim the requested amount
276	        _verifyCanClaimTokenAllocation(msg.sender, amount, investorVestingConfig, proof);
277	
278	        // Load the investor position
279	        InvestorPosition storage position = s_investorPositions[positionId];
280	
281	        // Cache Legion Sale Address Configuration
282	        LegionSaleAddressConfiguration memory addressConfig = s_addressConfig;
283	
284	        // Mark that the token amount has been settled
285	        position.hasSettled = true;
286	
287	        // Calculate the amount to be distributed on claim
288	        uint256 amountToDistributeOnClaim =
289	            amount * investorVestingConfig.tokenAllocationOnTGERate / Constants.TOKEN_ALLOCATION_RATE_DENOMINATOR;
290	
291	        // Calculate the remaining amount to be vested
292	        uint256 amountToBeVested = amount - amountToDistributeOnClaim;
